question: Which document, projection, schema, format and presentation contracts should own all exports, and which editing-runtime requirements can disappear?
trigger: User switched models and requested a final hostile audit of the whole-export direction against a supplied Claude audit.
requirements: Cut serializer-only editor construction, parallel authored serializer names and copied projection warning policy.
Preserve one captured document revision, authored conflict/refusal laws, named roots, configured codec behavior and format-specific diagnostics.
Support editor-bound convenience and detached saved-document conversion without activating editing lifecycles.
Keep semantic HTML, styled React presentation, DOCX, Markdown, JSON, text/plain and clipboard jobs explicit at their actual owners.
Apply the hard-cut counterfactual to plugin/configuration inputs, cleanup flags, result shapes and proposed export abstractions.
Review only: no product implementation, public API adoption or borrowed runtime proof.
evidenceReuse: Reused the bound twelve-unit export research and prior authored-capture execution for their exact claims. Re-read current authored diagnostics, Markdown/HTML/DOCX callers, NodeApi.string documentation and implementation, clipboard/table plain-text paths, and static HTML cleanup options. Treated the supplied audit as an untrusted candidate: accepted locally proven findings and excluded added editor comparisons not bound to the recorded corpus.
summary: Pursue the existing document-first direction, with three corrections. Structural plain text is a real schema-aware format job; NodeApi.string must retain separator-free offset semantics. Detached conversion consumes frozen schema/conversion configuration, not raw plugins or a live editor. Static HTML class/data stripping flags are workaround API to delete once semantic HTML owns clean interchange. Keep one diagnostic result shape per format and remove parallel authored serializer names, while preserving distinct semantic HTML, styled React, clipboard and DOCX jobs. No ExportPlugin, universal dispatcher or all-format Plite engine.

reconciliation.question: Which document, projection, schema, format and presentation contracts should own all exports, and which editing-runtime requirements can disappear?
reconciliation.reason: Retains document-first per-format conversion and the hard cut of serializer-only editors, but reverses the text disposition, narrows detached input from plugins to frozen conversion configuration, and adds deletion of static HTML cleanup flags.

reconciliation.question: Which document, projection, schema, format and presentation contracts should own all exports, and which editing-runtime requirements can disappear?
reconciliation.reason: The fixed-repository comparison and twelve-unit source audit remain valid for their exact claims. This pass adds local source findings and borrows no new runtime, native-viewer or performance proof.

alternatives: Keep the documented NodeApi.string recipe as plain-text export: Stop; nested structural boundaries disappear, including table cell boundaries.
Change NodeApi.string to insert separators: Stop; that breaks its documented offset/string job and cannot express feature-specific structures.
Schema-aware text/plain encoding through existing codec ownership: Pursue; Plite supplies structural defaults and Plate features supply richer mappings such as table TSV.
Pass raw plugins to detached serializers: Stop; raw declarations neither prove captured configured state nor avoid editing lifecycle activation.
Require callers to construct a public conversion-context/compiler object: Stop for now; editor methods and standalone functions can hide compilation until an independent reuse job proves the noun.
Keep separate ordinary and authored serializer methods: Stop; projection is an option and every format result should carry data plus diagnostics.
Collapse semantic HTML and styled React rendering: Stop; interchange and application presentation have different output promises even when projection is shared.
Retain stripClassNames, preserveClassNames and stripDataAttributes after semantic HTML exists: Stop; they post-process presentation markup into an approximate interchange format.
Universal ExportPlugin, export(format) dispatcher or all-format Plite package: Stop; no shared lifecycle or substrate-owned encoding job earns those abstractions.
Direct DOCX rewrite or new PDF engine: Defer; both still need matched fidelity, native artifact and complete-operation evidence.
proofLimits: Source-only reassessment. No product implementation, type proof, runtime/browser/native-viewer test or complete-operation benchmark was added. Exact detached signatures, structural text defaults for every feature, complete-document root/metadata behavior and DOCX backend remain design questions. The supplied extra ProseKit, Milkdown, Editor.js, Portable Text and Slate comparisons were not source-bound and do not support this record. The immutable research closure binds only lead-ledger.tsv and read-log.tsv among the six TSV ledgers; an exact-restoration claim for all six is therefore unproven, though no current corruption was found.
